system.description:
Target a character who has just received HP Damage from an attack. The target recovers [[/r 2d6 ]]{2D HP}. This skill may only be used once in response to a single attack.

(Hate Top): You may reduce the [Hate] cost of this skill to 0.

Magic that responds to an enemy's attack and heals allies' recent injuries. It is a <Treatment Priest>-specific recovery magic called Reaction Activated Recovery.
